pr_title: Discard missing background task at garbage collection
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
When a HA starts background task using `hass.async_create_background_taks` It adds a `add_done_call_back` to to task to enable cleanup.
When the backround task was ended through an exception cleanup will throw `Error doing job: Task was destroyed but it is pending`.
We do not catch this exceptin in HA.
To avoid this side effect we can `discard` a failing background Future at clean-up instead of removing it.

See also: https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio-task.html#asyncio.create_task

pr_comments:
The problem is likely here https://github.com/bamthomas/aioimaplib/blob/54a4de93cff81147d78385d4bf7b7d96db0aa91a/aioimaplib/aioimaplib.py#L392

No reference is saved to the task so as soon a cpython moves to the next line the task can be garbage collected because nothing is holding a strong reference to it anymore

Right, 

> The problem is likely here https://github.com/bamthomas/aioimaplib/blob/54a4de93cff81147d78385d4bf7b7d96db0aa91a/aioimaplib/aioimaplib.py#L392
> 
> No reference is saved to the task so as soon a cpython moves to the next line the task can be garbage collected because nothing is holding a strong reference to it anymore

Right. Knowing this it feels wrong to make a change in the way how we are doing garbage collection. I'll open an isssue on aioimaplib and close this PR.
